items.headline: Doeren leaves NC State 'with no grudges,' will always be rooting for Wolfpack
items.description: Former N.C. State coach Dave Doeren, speaking for the first time since his firing, said he leaves with no grudges and will be rooting for the Wolfpack.

items.headline: NC State's Goebbel vows to build on 'foundation' laid by fired coach Dave Doeren
items.description: New NC State interim coach Todd Goebbel thanked recently fired coach Dave Doeren on Friday, saying that he will field a team that Doeren "will be proud of."
